name: Giving Updates & Status Reports
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on giving updates & status reports -- practice these key phrases out loud:
We're on track to finish by Friday.
There's been a slight delay due to a dependency on another team.
The good news is that the main risk we flagged last week is resolved.
Next steps are to finalize the draft and get sign-off by Wednesday.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
